Look to Bitter Springs to see what happens to disloyal slaves.
{Player killed President Kimball} Kimball's assassin is always welcome here.
{Silus freed}The {Ken-TOO-ree-on} Centurion Silus will be punished for letting himself be captured. Coward.
{Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS} Legatus Lanius is come. The battle for the dam will soon begin!
{Late game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS} Legatus Lanius draws near. The Profligates' days are numbered.
{Elite Rangers have arrived}{trying not to sound worried} The black-armored Rangers are said to be fearsome in battle.
{Elite rangers on the way} There have been sightings of Rangers in black armor, the best the Profligates have to offer.
I wish I could hear the Profligates weeping over the explosion at McCarran!
The Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar protects you.
{Mr. House Unplugged/Killed} The warlord House thought himself beyond {KAI-zar's}Caesar's reach. And now he is dead.
{Caesar dead} The Legion will survive {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death. It must!
{Player destroyed Securitron Army} I felt the earth shake when the evil below the Fort was destroyed!
{Legion dogs killed} Our hounds were bred to kill. They are missed.
{Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope both wiped out} It's said that every living thing at Nelson and Forlorn Hope camp was killed.
{Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out}{cheerful} I hear the Profligates at Forlorn Hope begged for their lives.
{Nelson wiped out} The Legionaries at Nelson were killed to a man. No survivors.
{Great Khans signed treaty with NCR} So frightened are the Profligates that they've begun signing treaties with primitive tribes!
{Unknown} Watch yourself, Profligate.
{Unknown} Hold your tongue, wastrel.
{Unknown} Degenerates like you belong on a cross.
{Dislike}{contempt} Wretched Profligate. Try making some trouble.
{Dislike}{contempt} You belong on a cross, degenerate.
{Dislike} I'd rather kill you than talk to you.
{Hated} When the time comes, I'll be the one to kill you.
{Hated}{looking for an excuse to attack} Give me cause, Profligate.
{Hated} Attack me. Give me license to kill you.
{Mixed} You aren't trusted here, Profligate.
{Mixed}{Scornfully} You serve yourself, not the Legion.
{Mixed} Why is your degneracy tolerated?
{Wild Child} How are we to trust one such as you?
{Wild Child}{suspicious} Who knows what you'll do next?
{Wild Child} You're a crazed one. I'll not talk to you.
{Somewhat liked} {Most idiots try to defy the Legion}You do well to serve the Legion.
{Somewhat liked}{Most are forced to serve} You're wise to serve the Legion by choice.
{Somewhat liked} You've proved yourself useful, at least.
{Liked} We each serve the Legion, in our way.
{Liked}{LATIN} Good to see you, {ah-ME-cus}amicus.
{Liked}{LATIN} {AH-way, ah-ME-cus}Ave, amicus.
{Player killed President Kimball}{Officer} I've heard the stories of how you assassinated Kimball. It's all my Legionaries will about.
{Late game begins}{Officer} {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius will arrive soon enough - and with him comes slaughter.
{Middle game begins} {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is known as the Monster of the East - a name he has earned many times over.
{Elite rangers on the way}{Officer} The Legionaries fret like women over rumors of Rangers in black armor.
{Caesar cured}{officer} Never once did I believe that {KAI-zar}was near death. I have friends in high places.
{Rumors of Legion Veterans}{Officer} Soon the Legion's veterans will arrive from Arizona. Each has killed many times his number.
{Nelson wiped out}{officer} Had I been the commander of our forces at Nelson, the town would still be ours.
{Unknown}{Officer} Keep barking and I'll feed you to a dog.
{Wild Child}{Officer} You can't be trusted... but you're useful.
{Liked}{Officer} You serve the Legion well, {ah-ME-cus}amicus.
{Elite rangers have arrived}{Veteran} I keep an eye out for Rangers in black armor. I haven't killed one yet.
{Nelson wiped out}{veteran} Had the Legionaries at Nelson been more {beat}seasoned, we'd still hold the settlement.
{Unknown}{Veteran} I know your kind. You die easily enough.
{Legion Veterans arriving} Have you seen the Legion's veterans, arrived from Arizona? They are fearless!
{Rumors of Legion Veterans} It's said the Legion's veterans will arrive from Arizona soon. They are a sight to behold.
{Middle game begins} {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is on the march. When he arrives, the real slaughter will begin.
{Late game begins}{Veteran} I have fought beneath {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius many times. He cannot be defeated.
{Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Veteran} Finally, the dam will be assaulted. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is come.
{Player killed President Kimball}{Veteran}{recognizing player} Kimball's assassin. Nicely done.
